name: exploded-grinder-gpt-6.1-sol-s3-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a manual coffee grinder, as an SVG. Use a hand grinder with conical burrs rather than flat burrs.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1100" height="1560" viewBox="0 0 1100 1560">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#a6b6bb"/><stop offset=".25" stop-color="#edf3f2"/><stop offset=".53" stop-color="#c7d3d5"/><stop offset=".78" stop-color="#f5f8f6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#93a5ac"/></linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#765036"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#be8c5c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#815236"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="inside" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#1b3940"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#658d90"/></linearGradient>

      .leader{fill:none;stroke:#8b9c9e;stroke-width:1.2;stroke-linejoin:round}
      .label{font:600 18px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#253e44}
      .desc{font:14px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#687b7e}
      .num{font:600 13px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#fff;text-anchor:middle}
      .micro{font:11px 'Arial',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.8px;fill:#687b7e}
    </style>

  <path d="M359 864V904C359 940 551 940 551 904V864Z" fill="url(#gold)" class="outline"/>

  <ellipse cx="455" cy="864" rx="73" ry="23" fill="#80643e" class="outline"/>

  <path d="M62 1491H1038" stroke="#d4dcd8"/>
  <text x="62" y="1524" class="micro">HAND POWERED / CONICAL BURRS</text>

</svg>
